debugData.name: Showcase wetlands terrain
debugData.description: terrainShowcase's wetlands (p310 §3.5): mud01 (the base), mud02 (the channel, its banks and the hollows), grass02 (the raised ground) and rocks01 (the path and the bunker's pad) weighed by the block's COLOR_0 (RGB_AO, the AO on indirect light) through the height blend, DUAL_SCALE, and wet: puddles on ground flatter than 8°, rain ripples, and the regional wetness of the block's _WETNESS attribute (the default _wetness: three's GLTFLoader lowercases it), so the channel and the hollows stay wet in any weather.
